widget.title: Investment clock
widget.coverageNote: Coverage measures the share of methodology weight with matched data. It is not a probability or confidence level.
widget.noDrivers: No positive contributions to this phase in the bound snapshot.
widget.formula: Contribution = methodology weight × rule support. Totals are raw scores, not probabilities.
widget.frameworkNote: Theoretical mechanisms · a framework for interpreting scenarios, not a forecast or an asset allocation recommendation. Phases need not follow this order.
widget.inspectionNote: Inspecting a phase does not change the current classification.

recovery.meaning: Growth improves as inflation pressure eases.
recovery.signal: A theoretical recovery pairs strengthening demand with room for policy support.
recovery.watch: Watch output and employment stabilization alongside easing price pressure.

overheat.meaning: Growth and inflation pressure rise together.
overheat.signal: Capacity constraints can emerge as demand strengthens and policy tightens.
overheat.watch: Watch price persistence, production capacity and the policy response.

stagflation.meaning: Growth weakens while inflation pressure persists.
stagflation.signal: Supply pressure can constrain activity even as prices remain elevated.
stagflation.watch: Watch input costs, real demand and the tension facing monetary policy.

recession.meaning: Growth and inflation pressure both weaken.
recession.signal: Demand contraction can reduce pricing power and bring policy easing.
recession.watch: Watch employment, credit transmission and signs of demand stabilization.

summary.title: Macro
summary.subtitle: Key US / China indicators and collection status

methodology.availabilityBody: An observation is available from the moment this system first saw the value in an official source response (first_seen). Neither the FRED public CSV nor AKShare provides historical release times, so every value from the first backfill is available as of the backfill day; replay by availability is meaningful only after collection started.
methodology.sourcesBody: US series come from the FRED public CSV; the publisher is the original agency (e.g. BLS via FRED). China series are fetched through AKShare directly from official hosts (National Bureau of Statistics, ChinaBond, SAFE). Values are taken only by server-side parsers from the archived raw bytes; AKShare values serve only as a cross-check. Every number shows its fetch URL, fetch time, SHA-256 and line or JSON pointer in the evidence drawer.
methodology.missingBody: Missing items have no verifiable official source; restricted items are third-party data whose rights are unconfirmed and are neither collected nor stored until confirmed. Both show a reason; no zeros, no substitute definitions.
methodology.revisionsBody: When a period gets a new value, revisable series add a new version and keep the old one; for non-revisable series, or a contradiction inside one piece of evidence, the item is quarantined and the old value keeps serving.
methodology.eventsBody: US policy events are derived from changes in the Fed target range series, dated by effective date and never called announcements; the FOMC meeting calendar is shown separately. Cycles are computed by rule at read time; a direction is confirmed only after 6 months.
methodology.judgmentsOff: Judgment layer off: pages and APIs state facts only and carry no judgment fields.
